root_cause: WEBHOOK_URL on /frisse-blik was an empty string. The form then sent nothing while still showing the booking step, so commercial_leads stayed empty and leads were lost without any error.
fix: WEBHOOK_URL points to the Supabase Edge Function lead-intake (verify_jwt false, origin allow-list, field validation, idempotency key, stores into commercial_leads). Live tests before the PR: valid POST stored a row, invalid email 422, wrong origin 403.
prevention_rule: A form that reports success must have a verified server endpoint; an empty endpoint must fail visibly, never silently.
tests: live POST test recorded in the change document

live_readback: real submission on the live page creates one commercial_leads row
